projectDescription: A Rails Engine that provides a pristine, plug-and-play administrative portal leveraging Hotwire streaming, multiple front-end CSS frameworks (Bootstrap, Bulma, Tailwind, Semantic UI), and a declarative Elements system for building rich admin interfaces.
keyFeatures: Rails Engine — mount as a standalone admin interface with zero boilerplate
Hotwire streaming — index and dashboard actions streamed by default via ActionController::Live
Multi-framework UI — choose Bootstrap, Bulma, Tailwind, or Semantic UI (Fomantic-UI) per application
Declarative Elements system — define reusable UI components (menus, forms, tables) via a DSL
Extended routing DSL — resource(), resources(), dashboard(), widgets(), actions(), section(), authenticate() helpers
Multiple admin instances — run several named admin applications side-by-side in one Rails app
Namespace isolation options — full isolation, hybrid, or no isolation via isolate_namespace config
Parallel async processing — built-in concurrent_ruby / async support for heavy collection queries
Nested resource scoping — automatic chained belongs_to scoping for nested admin resources
Authentication integrations — supports Rails, custom, and Devise authentication providers
publicApiSurface: Torque::Admin[] — fetch or create a named Application instance
Torque::Admin.configure — configure the default admin application
Application#configure — yield config block for title, theme, base_controller, stream_actions, etc.
Routing#admin(name, path, **options, &block) — mount and define routes for an admin application
Mapper#resources(*resources, actions:, widgets:, source:) — declare admin resource routes
Mapper#resource(*resources, actions:, widgets:, source:) — declare singleton admin resource routes
Mapper#dashboard(path, partials:) — declare a dashboard route
Mapper#section(name) — group routes under a named sidebar section
Mapper#widgets(*list, action:, on:) — register widget routes for a resource
Mapper#actions(*actions, view:, via:) — register custom action routes
Mapper#authenticate(resource, with:) — configure authentication for a resource
Mapper#unauthenticated — mark a route block as public
Mapper#searchable(*resources) — add a search route to a resource
BaseController — concern included in your TAController, provides elements, frame, and settings DSL
ResourceController — full CRUD concern composed of Collection, Member, Index, Show, Form, Batch, Actions, Widgets
CollectionController#collection — returns the current paginated, filtered, sorted collection
MemberController#resource / #member — finds and memoizes the current record
StreamController.stream_from_actions(*actions) — opt actions into HTTP streaming
Elements::Base — base class for all custom admin elements
UiBuilder.add_framework(name, mod) — register a new CSS framework helper module
DEFAULT_CONFIG — InheritableOptions with title, theme, root_path, stream_actions, isolate_namespace, base_controller, parallel_processing_with, elements_lookup_context, resources
